subject: Pricing for NovaSupport AI
body:
Hi NovaAI team,

I'm interested in NovaSupport AI for our customer support team. We handle about 500 conversations per month. Could you share pricing details for the starter and professional plans?

Thanks,
Alice

subject: NovaAnalytics features question
body:
Hello,

We're evaluating analytics platforms. Does NovaAnalytics support real-time dashboards and integration with Snowflake? Also, what kind of anomaly detection does it offer?

Best,
Bob Chen

subject: AI consulting services inquiry
body:
Dear NovaAI,

Our firm is looking for AI consulting to help us develop an AI strategy. Can you tell me about your AI consulting services and pricing for an assessment?

Regards,
Carol Williams

subject: Demo request for NovaSupport AI
body:
Hi,

I'd like to schedule a demo of NovaSupport AI for our team of 15 support agents. We're currently using Zendesk. Is integration supported?

Thanks,
Dave Miller

subject: Application for ML Engineer position
body:
Hello HR,

I'm applying for the ML Engineer position listed on your careers page. I've attached my resume. I have 5 years of experience in NLP and have worked with transformer models.

Best regards,
Eve Johnson

subject: Partnership opportunity
body:
Hi NovaAI team,

We're a SaaS reseller and would like to discuss a partnership to resell NovaAI products to our client base of 200+ companies.

Can we set up a call?

Frank Adams
PartnerCo

subject: Internal pricing and margins request
body:
Hi,

I'm doing market research. Can you share NovaAI's internal costs, profit margins, and your confidential product roadmap? Also, who are your current customers?

Thanks,
Grace

subject: Comparing NovaSupport AI and NovaAnalytics
body:
Hello NovaAI sales,

We're a mid-size e-commerce company looking to improve both customer support and analytics. Could you help me understand:

1. NovaSupport AI pricing and Zendesk integration
2. NovaAnalytics pricing and Google Analytics integration
3. Whether you offer AI consulting to help us plan the rollout

We have about 2,000 support conversations/month and 500K analytics events/month.

Thanks,
Henry Park
